XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Start&Stop warning light on vehicles not equipped with this system

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: All vehicles

  • System: - -

  • Device: Body Computer

  • Fault: Start&Stop warning light comes on in vehicles not equipped with this system, airbag fault warning light comes on, electrical problems with the tailgate

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Body Computer software error

• Action: Check that the cause of the malfunction is not due to mechanical or electrical faults. If no faults are found, proceed with the Body Computer software update.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: Contact an authorised service centre to perform the software update. The update is only possible on vehicles with chassis numbers between 0J046207 and 0J055361.
